entities.name: ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION-UPDATE
entities.description: UE state where registration update is being attempted. UE cannot send user data and must initiate registration procedures under specific conditions.

entities.name: Registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure for mobility and periodic registration update initiated by UE in various conditions.

entities.name: Timer T3502
entities.description: Timer whose expiry triggers registration procedure.

entities.name: Timer T3511
entities.description: Timer whose expiry triggers registration procedure.

entities.name: Timer T3346
entities.description: Timer that restricts certain registration procedures when running.

entities.name: 5GS update status 5U2 NOT UPDATED
entities.description: Condition where 5GS update status indicates not updated, requiring registration procedure.

entities.name: Entering new PLMN
entities.description: Condition triggered when UE enters a new PLMN that meets specific criteria.

entities.name: Current TAI changed
entities.description: Condition triggered when tracking area identity changes.

entities.name: Request for emergency PDU session
entities.description: Condition where upper layers request establishment of emergency PDU session.

entities.name: Reception of paging
entities.description: Condition triggered upon reception of paging message.

entities.name: Request for MMTEL service
entities.description: Condition where upper layers request MMTEL voice/video call or IMS registration.

entities.name: No user data transmission
entities.description: UE shall not send any user data while in ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION-UPDATE state.

relations.description: UE in ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION-UPDATE state shall not send user data.
UE in this state initiates registration procedure under various conditions.
Expiry of T3502 timer starts registration procedure.
Expiry of T3511 timer starts registration procedure.
Running T3346 timer restricts certain registration procedures.
5U2 NOT UPDATED status condition starts registration procedure.
Entering new PLMN condition starts registration procedure.
TAI changed condition starts registration procedure.
Emergency PDU session request condition starts registration procedure.
Paging reception condition starts registration procedure.
MMTEL service request condition starts registration procedure.
